body:
🤖 Six original repository attempts now have audited, durably archived evidence. Two new failure modes are distinct from the earlier bootstrap/API timeouts:

- LAMMPS exhausted 20 bootstrap BASH turns ($0.938712 actual). Seventeen saved commands retained trailing `</s>` or `</thinking>` tags and produced Bash syntax errors; upstream's unchanged sanitizer does not strip those tags. No bootstrap image or PR discovery was reached. Full unparsed responses/finish reasons were not retained, so this does not establish that the output-token limit caused the tags. [Transcript diagnosis](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/37b1b0479e91af69e57bbcddf7a2843932b454f2/experiments/28-catalogued-fields/results/lammps__lammps-bootstrap-diagnostics.json).
- Matchms passed both bootstrap smoke and fresh-image tests (1444 passed, two skipped at the pinned newer revision; five calls, $0.133545 actual), then failed during native PR validation. Of 11 returned PRs, four entered: PR966 had `ModuleNotFoundError: chemap` in both stages at its historical base; PR958 then aborted Docker exec with `OSError(errno=7)`. Exact source/test patch hashes match a read-only reconstruction of the original post-fix script: 425528 bytes passed as one argv argument by upstream. Seven returned candidates were never entered, and no task exported. No reconstructed command was executed. [Transport diagnosis](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/37b1b0479e91af69e57bbcddf7a2843932b454f2/experiments/28-catalogued-fields/results/matchms__matchms-transport-diagnostics.json) · [Reproducible string-only analysis](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/37b1b0479e91af69e57bbcddf7a2843932b454f2/experiments/28-catalogued-fields/diagnose_transport.py).

All six original archives passed fresh anonymous HF object/member hash readback, billing reconciliation and owned Docker cleanup. Their partial total is $3.030972 in actual model charges and 9.890026 allocated CPU-hours. One Scanpy task meets the declared tracked-test contract; zero verified oracle commands resolve completely. These are partial cohort results, not estimates of the prevalence of suitable PRs. [All ten repositories and current evidence states](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/37b1b0479e91af69e57bbcddf7a2843932b454f2/experiments/28-catalogued-fields/cohort-report.md) · [Actual discovery coverage](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/37b1b0479e91af69e57bbcddf7a2843932b454f2/experiments/28-catalogued-fields/results/candidate-coverage.json).

Cobrapy is the seventh original run and remains active. Inputs/model/resource limits are unchanged. No dependency reinstall at historical bases, parser/tag fix, patch-transport repair, generation retry, candidate bypass or longer-timeout diagnostic has been applied. The remaining fixed-cohort repositories will retain the same protocol.
